summary: The candidate writes positional part values under both the position key and an item-id alias, and reconciles id-less terminal parts against every buffered position. Both follow-up findings are covered by new regression tests, and no introduced defect was found in the streamed or buffered Chat paths.

evidence: src/chat/stream-translation.ts lines 82-135 add the item-id alias via setChatOutputTextPart and reconcile id-less terminal parts against all buffered output positions.
The aggregate check joins output-keyed parts and compares them to the terminal item, so two ha parts followed by an id-less haha aggregate no longer emit a third ha.
src/chat/completions.ts routes all output-text and refusal part writes through setChatOutputTextPart in both streamed and buffered completion paths.
tests/auth-responses-branch-coverage.test.ts adds regressions for the all-positions aggregate repeat and for reusing the item-id alias when output_index is omitted.
